subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should this narrow Sessions list preview land independently now, be repaired through the open linked PR, or be folded into the broader sessions workspace design?
rationale: The backend contract exists and the UI gap is source-proven, but the linked external PR is conflicting/proof-needed and broader Sessions UX issues overlap with the same surface.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue paired with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 and ask for a conflict-free branch that uses `lastMessagePreview` plus real Control UI proof.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow replacement
options.body: Use a maintainer-backed replacement only after deciding the stale linked branch should not be repaired.

options.title: Fold into sessions workspace
options.body: Defer the row-preview display into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want a larger sessions-overview design instead of an incremental preview.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue paired with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 and ask for a conflict-free branch that uses `lastMessagePreview` plus real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Control UI Sessions page history points to steipete as the strongest current-code routing owner.
